_readme: Hand-kept figures with no free daily feed. Edit v (and date, label, src) when a new number is published. Leave prev out: the updater fills it with the last different value it saw. src is a source key already on the page; for a new source add it to 'sources' below.

h100_1yr.label: Apr 2026
h100_1yr.note: SemiAnalysis one-year contract index, midpoint of the 25th to 75th percentile range ($2.10 to $2.70). prev is the October 2025 reading; keep it until a reading from a year after it exists.

capex_2027.label: Use a number (% vs 2026) once guided, or "cut"

labs._note: Stance model inputs, $B. cash = cash and short-term investments; commit = fixed or planned compute spending it has to pay for; rev = calendar 2026 revenue, the base for the 2027 to 2030 paths; arr = latest annualized revenue, used for today's reading.

openai.note: cash counts the whole March 2026 round, so the ratio is an upper bound

anthropic.rev_note: nine months reported ($33.2B) plus a fourth quarter at the third quarter's $17.0B; our estimate

dc_build._note: North American primary markets: under construction and built capacity, MW. Preleased share comes from 'preleased'.

funding._note: Used when the live FRED readings are missing. ipo_window: open or shut.
funding.fed_note: Fed raised to 3.75–4.00% in September; a December hike about 78% priced
